'''Oslumpex V''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector's]] [[Oslumpex system/Legends|Oslumpex system]], located at the crossroads of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Authority Arc]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]]. Situated near the Corporate Sector's border with the [[Wyl sector/Legends|Wyl sector]], Oslumpex V served as a convenient entrance point for outside goods, and was a rich world as a result. The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] largest [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] was located on Oslumpex V, along with a headquarters for [[starshipwright]]s' unions and drydocks that serviced many [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and tramp [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="tea" /> One of the companies that called Oslumpex V home was [[Starshipwrights and Aerospace Engineers Incorporated]], which worked on [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' during his smuggling days&mdash;and were left stiffed on a bill for 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="hsr" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oslumpex V was first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1979]].<ref name="hsr" />
